messages:
maria: CI main is red, multiple integ jobs failing after the last deploy — looks like the test fixture orchestrator crashed in ci-ns. failing jobs: integ/feature-store, integ/session-store. anyone around? @jonathan @kyle
ci-bot: [automated] alert — fixture-orchestrator heartbeat missing in ci-ns for 5m. Pod status: CrashLoopBackOff. Recent events attached.
maria: pasting latest pod logs:
```
2026-03-16T10:12:34Z orchestrator ERROR: fatal: segmentation fault
2026-03-16T10:12:34Z kernel: Killed process 2245 (orchestrator) total-vm:1024000kB, anon-rss:812000kB
2026-03-16T10:12:35Z orchestrator INFO: shutdown hook fired
...
```
jonathan: ack — I'll try a manual restart of the fixture-orchestrator. can we avoid mass reruns until we know cause?
kyle: helm rollback didn't help earlier. i'm going to scale replicas 0->1 and tail logs. hold off on merging anything to main for a bit.
sasha: queued a targeted rerun for the dependent jobs so we don't flood CI: `cictl rerun --jobs integ/feature-store,integ/session-store --pr 4321`
jonathan: after scaling, init logs show mount errors: `initdb: could not open file: permission denied` on the test PVC. looks like PVC mount lost proper fsGroup after the kube upgrade.
maria: that would explain the OOM then crash — process couldn't access state dir, kept retrying & ballooned. @eng-infra any context on recent kubelet changes?
kyle: pinged infra in #eng-infra — they confirmed a kubelet upgrade earlier this morning changed fsGroup handling on some node OS images. temporary fix is to set securityContext.fsGroup: 1000 on the statefulset for test fixtures (we already applied this in staging).
maria: can someone open a tiny chart patch to apply to ci-ns? prefer a quick PR so we have audit trail.
sasha: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci-charts/pull/789 — includes fsGroup change + a preStop hook to drain gracefully. doing a canary deploy to ci-ns/test-fixtures now :thumbsup:
ci-bot: deploy succeeded in ci-ns/test-fixtures; orchestrator pod status Running; heartbeats restored.
maria: rerunning the two failed jobs now. thanks all.
ci-bot: rerun queued: integ/feature-store #5678, integ/session-store #3456
maria: both reruns passed. closing the loop here. brief follow-up: add postmortem note — root cause kubelet upgrade + fsGroup semantics change -> PVC mount permission denied -> orchestrator OOM/crash. will add steps to our CI runbook for future kube upgrades. :white_check_mark:
